LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_GoldenSpirit.label: (Raven) Golden Spirit
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_GoldenSpirit.description: A supreme will forged by absorbing gold and treasures. This power continuously strengthens the Grand Commander's body and soul.\n\nThe current progress determines the magnitude of enhancement. At 100%, the ultimate form is achieved.
